test_title: PYST 28: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the Council of Ministers is correct?

options.text: Ministers of State rank higher than Cabinet Ministers.
Cabinet Ministers are a smaller group within the Council of Ministers.
The Council of Ministers is appointed by the Chief Justice
All members of the Council of Ministers are part of the Cabinet.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Cabinet Ministers are a smaller group within the Council of Ministers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Council of Ministers in India consists of three categories: **Cabinet Ministers**, **Ministers of State**, and **Deputy Ministers**.
